messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident 1870012468 opened by anomaly-detector — elevated errors and latency on agent/tool invocation code paths in us-west-2. Error rate for toolcall endpoints rose from 0.8% -> 18% over 7m. Affected: hosted API, bursty bursts from mixture of chat+function_call requests. Observability: pods 3-9 on nodegroup-rt-7 at 92% CPU. Paging oncall-eng.

ana: ack — I'm on it. grabbing traces and logs now. any immediate customer alerts?

sara: support is seeing >50 tickets mentioning "tool failed" from mid-market tenants. No P0 customers hit yet, but some dedicated customers seeing timeouts.

mike: taking the incident. quick triage: root seems to be heavy KV-cache churn when tool_call=enabled combined with long streaming structured_output. Suggest immediate mitigation plan:
- Step 1: soft-rate-limit agent.invoke globally (reduce to 20% of normal throughput for hosted)
- Step 2: flip structured_output -> plain_text for hosted tier (disable json streaming)
- Step 3: disable agent/tool calling for self-serve tenants (non-enterprise) as fallback
- Step 4: route remaining heavy requests to dedicated fallback pool and enable shorter timeouts

jordan: agree. add: temporarily bump batching thresholds to reduce per-token overhead.

ana: commands ready — will apply step 1 then monitor. Posting commands here.

ana: ```bash
# soft-rate-limit agent invokes for hosted
curl -s -X POST "https://ops.internal.redwood/api/v1/feature_toggles" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"agent.invoke.rate_multiplier":0.2}'
```

mike: deployed rate_multiplier=0.2 to hosted (rolling). watching metrics: error rate initial dip, latency trending down.

ana: next: disable structured output streaming for hosted

ana: ```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://ops.internal.redwood/api/v1/config" \n -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n -d '{"structured_output.mode":"plain","structured_output.strict":false}'
```

mike: rolled structured_output to plain for hosted. note: this will change SDK behavior — customers will get flattened text until we revert.

lia: PM/nrr: please draft a short note for customer-systems channel and statuspage. Mention degraded agent/tool performance and that structured JSON output is temporarily disabled to protect latency.

sara: will prepare support blurb and triage playbook for affected tickets.

jordan: monitoring: CPU dropped from 92% -> 67% across the nodes within 2 min, toolcall error rate down to 4%. Good.

mike: final fallback if surge remains: disable agent.invoke for non-enterprise tenants completely. prepping command.

mike: ```bash
# emergency cutoff for self-serve
curl -s -X POST "https://ops.internal.redwood/api/v1/feature_toggles" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"agent.invoke.enabled_for_tier":{"self_serve":false}}'
```

ana: holding on executing that — wait for support impact metrics. current trend stable but still noisy.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Action applied: structured_output.mode -> plain (hosted). rate_multiplier=0.2 (hosted). Observed stabilization window at 2026-03-15T10:18:14Z.

mike: notes for post-incident: need better backpressure for function calls at edge, per-tenant KV cache isolation, and non-blocking structured output path. Also add guardrails in SDK (client-side rate limiting) to prevent sudden bursts.

lia: will co-ordinate customer comms. Support will notify impacted customers in next 30m, statuspage incident created.

sara: support blurb ready and pinned in #support: "We're seeing errors for tool/function calls; structured JSON output is temporarily disabled for hosted customers to protect latency. We'll update as we progress."

ana: handing off to mike for incident lead. I'll stay for followups. mike has primary.

mike: thanks. action items captured in the incident doc. plan to keep restrictions for at least 1 hour, then slowly relax if metrics remain stable. scheduling postmortem for tomorrow 11:00 PT.

ops-bot: :page_facing_up: Incident 1870012468 — mitigations applied. Please update the incident playbook with exact toggles used.

mike: closing loop: will prepare RCA outline and link to runbook changes once we confirm no regression in next 2h.

ana: thx team. small reminder: update SDK changelog for structured_output behavioral change so customers don't get surprises.
